MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is √100? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 100
   C. 10
   D. 11

2. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 24
   C. 36
   D. 12

3. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 49
   C. 1
   D. 1

4. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 4

5. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 8
   C. 17
   D. 0

6. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 14
   C. 49
   D. 7

7. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 17
   C. 23
   D. 7

8. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 10
   D. 4

9. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 6x
   D. 12x

10. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 31
   C. 2
   D. 1

11. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 57
   B. 56
   C. 15
   D. 1

12. Solve for x: x + 7 = 16. (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 9
   C. 10
   D. 7

13. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 10 000 m²
   B. 100 000 m²
   C. 1000 m²
   D. 100 m²

14. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 55
   B. 16
   C. 22
   D. 32

15. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.6
   B. 31
   C. 31.7
   D. 37

16. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. Cannot tell
   C. 1/4
   D. They are equal

17. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 81
   C. 18
   D. 82

18. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 2/3
   B. 1/2
   C. 1/4
   D. 3/4

19. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 90
   C. 36
   D. 18

20. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 40
   C. 75
   D. 20

21. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 26
   C. 5
   D. 25

22. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 22
   C. 122
   D. 121

23. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 2.5
   B. 0.25
   C. 0.205
   D. 0.025

24. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 41
   B. 13
   C. 3
   D. 40

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

28. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

29. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
